title: Tambacounda collective’s planned march for the University of Eastern Senegal
reason: The planned march was expressly prohibited and cancelled; no qualifying public gathering or turnout is documented.
notes: The Jan 26 Leral report says a regional collective planned a Jan 29 march. The opened Jan 29 Teranga News report quotes an organizer saying the prefect prohibited it and the collective complied. The group planned flyer distribution and decided to hand a memorandum to the governor that day, but the report does not confirm either activity was completed. No qualifying public gathering or attendance is documented. A separate July 2021 march by the same collective is outside this unit.

title: February Sonko-affair protests reported in a later EnQuête issue
reason: Outside the January unit and reported as a separate later political episode, not physical continuation of the January curfew or public-lighting actions.
notes: The Feb 10 EnQuête issue covers Sonko-affair activity in Dakar, Ziguinchor and Bignona around the Feb 8–10 period. Exact relative date for each sub-event is not resolved here. Keep separate from January; this report does not assess eligibility or count these later actions.

title: Road transport intersyndical strike against control practices, reported ended Jan 3
reason: The strike is documented, but neither opened contemporary report establishes a qualifying public meeting or attendance of at least 50 people.
notes: The Jan 3 DakarActu article and Jan 4 Teranga News article report that the intersyndical strike ended after negotiations with state officials. Teranga says it was declared 10 days earlier without an exact start date; a separate Jan 4 SenePlus report says it had been underway since Dec 25. This establishes the work-stoppage period, not the date of a physical gathering. The reports describe grievances about road/police/customs controls, fines and weigh stations, and government commitments, but no public meeting or crowd count. Transport disruption is not turnout; no MM continuation is assigned without gathering evidence.

title: Transporter manifestation and toll-highway blockade reported by Dakar24
reason: The opened report dates the action to Jan 21, 2023, outside January 2021; it also gives no participant count.
notes: The article reports a manifestation by drivers on the toll highway during a transport strike after a government meeting. It says drivers blocked the highway and attacked buses/private vehicles but gives no attendance count. This is not part of the Dec 2020–Jan 2021 strike and is not coded in this unit.
